findings.title: Upsampling check uses outer dataset instead of scoped_dataset
findings.body: `is_errors_query_for_error_upsampled_projects` is passed the outer `dataset`, not the `scoped_dataset` that is actually queried. In the dashboard split path, the outer dataset is metrics_enhanced while the query runs against discover with `!event.type:transaction`. The upsampling decision is then wrong for the query being run. Upsampled_count may also be applied to RPC or other datasets where the function does not exist, causing query failures.

findings.title: Cache key uses Python hash(), invalidation is unreliable and keys can collide
findings.body: Python `hash()` of a tuple is not guaranteed stable across processes or versions. More importantly, a hash can collide, so two different project sets can share one cache key and return the wrong eligibility. Combined with the 60s cache, this also makes the mocked-options tests order-dependent: one test's cached result can leak into the next. `invalidate_upsampling_cache` is never called when the option changes, so stale results persist.

findings.title: Substring match on event.type:error misfires on negations
findings.body: `"event.type:error" in query` also matches `!event.type:error` and queries that OR in transactions. Upsampling would then be applied to non-error or mixed queries, where `sample_weight` is absent or meaningless.

findings.title: upsampled_count has no null handling for sample_weight
findings.body: `sum(sample_weight)` gives undercounted results when `sample_weight` is null or 0 for events. Examples are events ingested before the field existed, or events without client sampling. The comment simply assumes these cases never occur. A fallback such as `ifNull(sample_weight, 1)` would be safer.

findings.title: Accidental submodule committed
findings.body: A gitlink `sentry-repo` pointing at the base commit was added. This is an accidental artifact and breaks clones and CI that fetch submodules.

findings.title: Eligibility check repeated per _get_event_stats call
findings.body: The eligibility check runs on every `_get_event_stats` invocation, which can be up to three times per request in the split flow. Each run does a cache round-trip, so the claimed performance optimization adds overhead instead.
